findings.affected_surface: src/status/runs-watch.js assemble() inputs decision and compare (P1W W1a/W1g/W2a/W2e/W3a)
findings.claim: Two of the four hard-coded watcher inputs have no row that removes the hard-coding. W1a replaces progress, and W1g replaces planned. No row changes the watcher to read decision.json (W2a) into decision. No row changes it to read compare-record.json (W2e) into compare. Writing those files therefore leaves decision: null and compare: [] on every publish, so 要你決定 (decision path) and the compare section never light up from those writers.
findings.evidence: Fact (a): runs-watch.js:394 hard-codes progress: null, decision: null, planned: null, compare: []. W2a only says it writes a single decision.json via a helper. W2e only says the image-review seat produces compare-record.json. W3a reads tasks/attention/work-order phase/decisions sidecar, but not decision.json or compare records. No row names the assemble() change for decision or compare.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1a, W1g, W2a, W2e, W3a; 起因 bullet citing src/status/runs-watch.js:394
findings.repair: Add explicit publish-side rows. W2a-pub: the watcher discovers decision.json at a defined scoped path and passes it as decision. W2e-pub: the watcher discovers compare-record/1 files for the root and passes compare. Both are mechanism rows that are independent of the guidance writers and can ship in v2.37.0, so the field shows 來源未接 until a writer exists. Add these rows to W3a and W4 dependencies.

findings.affected_surface: planned and decisions-made count for non-campaign modes (dev-flow, /l3)
findings.claim: planned has a writer only for campaigns (W1g reads the campaign execution graph). For dev-flow and /l3 without a campaign, no row gives planned a writer, and the row does not state the honest fallback. W1h covers only engine auto-adjudications. Depth-0 proxy decisions (depth0-control-loop.md:406, never produced a file) have no mechanism writer, and no guidance row covers them either, so the 代你決定 count stays a partial undercount without saying so.
findings.evidence: W1g: watcher builds planned from campaign execution graph/controller receipt. W1h: engine 自動裁決 append only. P5 step 1 requires depth-0 to append decision rows, but no P1W row (mechanism or guidance) owns that.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1g, W1h; §4 P5 順序 1
findings.repair: State that planned in non-campaign modes shows 來源未接, or derive it from the W1d task list as a display-only plan. Add a guidance row (eval-gated) for depth-0 decision appends. Label the W2d count as 'engine-only until W2x' so it is not read as complete.

findings.affected_surface: W1i honest-text rule; band verdict words and fields fed by W1d/W1e/W2a/W2b/W2c/W2e/W3b
findings.claim: W1i defines the 來源未接 text but not how a reader distinguishes 'source not wired' from 'source wired, currently empty'. Once W2a ships, an absent decision.json must render as 目前沒有待你決定, but before W2a ships the same absence must render as 來源未接. No signal is defined to tell these apart. The plan also does not say what 要你決定 and 待命 show while W1d/W1e wait on spikes. Showing 待命 when attention is unwired would be a misleading value.
findings.evidence: W1i: 來源未接時寫「來源未接」. 出貨切分: guidance rows ship later as PATCH, and until then the band shows 來源未接. No capability/wiring flag is defined. Verdict precedence 要你決定＞…＞待命 in W3a falls through to 待命 when inputs are absent.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1i, W3a, 出貨切分 bullet
findings.repair: Have the watcher publish a per-field sources_wired map, derived from the installed version and the presence of the writer hook or script. Readers render 來源未接 when a field is unwired, and null or none only when it is wired. Specify that the verdict falls back to a 待命（部分來源未接） qualifier instead of plain 待命 when attention or decision is unwired.

findings.affected_surface: P1W 依賴 column (W3a, W2c, W2a)
findings.claim: W3a is missing edges to writers it reads or displays: W1g (planned), W1b (完成待驗收 now uses campaign terminal state or acceptance), W1i (same mod/band text files), and W1c (watcher presence for dev-flow). W2c -> W1c is likely spurious, because run-ledger heartbeat writing does not need watcher autostart. W2a -> W1e is an ordering preference, not a data dependency.
findings.evidence: W3a 依賴 = W1a,W1d,W1e,W1f,W2d only, but its text says 完成待驗收改看 campaign 終態 and the mod shows planned. W2c says the watcher merges into the envelope, which needs only the watcher code, not autostart.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W table, 依賴 column for W3a, W2c, W2a
findings.repair: Set W3a deps to W1a, W1b, W1c, W1d, W1e, W1f, W1g, W1i, W2d, plus the new decision/compare publish rows. Drop W2c -> W1c, or justify it. Mark W2a -> W1e as sequencing-only.

findings.affected_surface: Wave 1 parallel dispatch: W1a, W1b, W1c, W1f, W1h, W1i
findings.claim: Wave 1 rows are not file-independent. W1a and W1f both modify the runs-watch.js assemble() call (progress/phase vs elapsed). W1a and W1i both modify render-review-page.js (buildPhase source vs honest text). W1c and W1b (if the merge trigger is a hook) both touch hooks/hooks.json, hook inventory, and hook-count/sync-version. Every row bumps CHANGELOG/version. Parallel dispatch will collide or force ad-hoc serialization.
findings.evidence: W1a: watcher passes progress and phase to assemble, and renderer buildPhase changes. W1f: elapsed no longer uses the oldest manifest (same assemble path). W1i: review page and band text. W1c: SessionStart hook registered in hook-classes. The plan claims 同一波內互相獨立.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W 平行派法 bullet and rows W1a, W1c, W1f, W1i
findings.repair: Add a per-row 'touches' column. Either serialize W1a -> W1f on runs-watch.js and W1a -> W1i on render-review-page.js, or merge them. Assign one owner row for hooks.json, inventory, and hook-count changes in the wave. Defer CHANGELOG and version bumps to W4 so rows do not conflict on them.

findings.affected_surface: Row classification W2a, W2c, W1b trigger, W1f export
findings.claim: Several rows mix mechanism and guidance or leave the class open. W2a bundles a helper script (mechanism) with a skill step (guidance). W2c is classified as 先查…缺的部分為指引, which is undecided. W1b's 'merge 後' trigger has no named firing mechanism; if a skill step must call it, it is guidance, not mechanism. W1f's depth-0 export of ROOT_RUN_ID is a mechanism only if the rail does it without a skill-text change. The W1b plausibility claim (finish-flow L-5.3 already reads the file) is consistent with fact (b).
findings.evidence: W2a: helper script ＋ depth-0 在 DOA 邊界問 owner 時寫；指引變更. W2c: 先查現行是否已寫. W1b: 觸發點 campaign 終態、merge 後. CLAUDE.md: never mix mechanism and guidance in one commit.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1b, W1f, W2a, W2c; fact (e)
findings.repair: Split W2a into W2a-m (helper script, mechanism, no eval) and W2a-g (skill text, eval ON/OFF), each in its own commit. Resolve W2c into explicit m and g sub-rows after a quick read. Name W1b's merge trigger as a script or hook entry point, or reclassify that trigger as guidance. State that W1f is a rail-only change with no SKILL.md edits.

findings.affected_surface: P1W release gate (W4 owner ssh+tmux real run)
findings.claim: The gate is not falsifiable. Four problems: (1) 'band 每格是真值' has no per-cell pass/fail definition; (2) the gate conflicts with shipping v2.37.0 while guidance cells legitimately show 來源未接; (3) one ordinary run per mode will usually never exercise 要你決定, 疑似卡住, or 完成待驗收, so those cells cannot be observed; (4) the mode list omits /l6 and ceo-agent without /lN, which the plan itself names as unwired.
findings.evidence: P1W 規則: 發版門檻 = 各工作模式各跑一次，band 每格是真值（測試 kit 的樹不算）. W4: dev-flow, /l3, /l4, /l5. Fact (c) names ceo-agent without /lN. 出貨切分 allows 來源未接 at v2.37.0.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W 規則 bullet, row W4, 出貨切分 bullet
findings.repair: Write a gate matrix of mode x cell. For each cell, give the expected source file and the check that the band value equals that source, independently read at a timestamped moment. Classify each cell as true value, 來源未接 (allowed only for listed guidance rows), or fail. Add scripted triggers for each verdict word: a permission prompt, a stall fixture run, and campaign completion. Add /l6 and ceo-agent rows. Require a real project_key and a real root_run_id that do not originate from a test kit, recorded with the band text.

findings.affected_surface: Default-on hooks W1c (SessionStart), W1d (PostToolUse Task), W1e (attention)
findings.claim: Only W1c mentions a disable knob and hook-classes. None of the three rows states latency cost, knob name, hook-inventory registration, hook-count bump, or semver class. The count interacts with P1d (32) and P3 (33). New hooks are PATCH but are slated into the MINOR v2.37.0. W1d's matcher 'Task 工具' is ambiguous: it could include the Agent/Task subagent tool and spawn Node on every call, against the P2 baseline. W1c does not bound the detached spawn per SessionStart, for example with a foreground flock -n probe before spawning.
findings.evidence: W1c: default-on＋關閉旋鈕＋進 hook-classes. W1d: PostToolUse（Task 工具）hook. W1e: hook → attention. P1d: --hook-count 32. P3: --hook-count 33. Fact (e): new hook is PATCH and must be registered in hook-classes and inventory.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1c, W1d, W1e; §4 P1d, P3 包裝
findings.repair: For each hook row, state: matcher (TaskCreate|TaskUpdate only), knob name in ~/.autopilot/config.json, expected per-call cost measured with the P2 instrument, hooks.json, inventory, and hook-classes entries, and the resulting hook count. Reconcile counts across P1d, P3, and P1W. State that W1c probes the lock in the foreground and spawns only when the lock is free.

findings.affected_surface: New files <live>/tasks/<sid>.json, <live>/attention/<sid>.json, decision.json, decisions sidecar, task-status bundle
findings.claim: The new contracts have no schemas, scope keys, or writer discipline. tasks/<sid>.json holds aggregate counts that concurrent PostToolUse invocations would read-modify-write without a lock. decision.json has no defined location or scope (project, root, or sid), and no stated single writer. The sidecar and bundle do not state null-vs-0 semantics. The plan does not say whether new assemble() inputs extend runs-live/1, which is additionalProperties:false per P5.
findings.evidence: W1d: subject, status, counts, current in_progress, first_created_at, with no lock or atomic-rename note. W2a: 單一 decision.json without a path. P5: runs-live/1 is additionalProperties:false, so the sidecar is used.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W rows W1d, W1e, W2a, W2d, W1b; §4 P5 順序 2
findings.repair: Add a schemas/*.schema.json entry per file with an owner and the scope key in the filename (project_key, root_run_id, or sid). Writes go through jsonl-store or flock plus atomic rename, and counts are recomputed from the event list rather than incremented. Unknown values are null. State which envelope or sidecar carries each new assemble() input without changing runs-live/1.

findings.affected_surface: W1c watcher autostart from SessionStart (dev-flow, ceo-agent without /lN)
findings.claim: The existing --idle-exit rule keeps the watcher alive only while an unexpired session-mode marker exists. Dev-flow sessions, the exact case W1c targets, have no marker. A hook-started watcher therefore self-exits after 3600 s with no live runs while the session is still open. SessionStart does not re-fire, so the band goes stale mid-session and the dev-flow release cell fails. Scope is also undefined: 專案有 project_key is circular for unmarked repos (fact c), and if the hook computes the key from cwd, every git repo session on the host starts a watcher. The plan does not cover the resource bound, the opt-in for non-autopilot repos, or session-end cleanup.
findings.evidence: P1a: idle-exit requires no unexpired ~/.autopilot/session-mode/<sid>.json marker for the project_key. Fact (c): the watcher starts only via session-mode set, and mod resolution falls back to paths that only a running watcher writes. W1c: 專案有 project_key 就確保 watcher；閒置自退.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W row W1c; §4 P1a watcher 生命週期; fact (c)
findings.repair: Have the W1c hook compute project_key from cwd via project-key.js. Have it write a lightweight session-presence marker (sid, project_key, expires_at short TTL, refreshed by an existing per-turn hook or the Stop hook) that idle-exit counts. Limit autostart to repos with an autopilot opt-in (config or presence of the .autopilot dir). State the interaction with session-mode set: the same lock, so the first starter wins. Add a test for many concurrent sessions sharing one watcher per project.

findings.affected_surface: W0b spike, W1d task writer, W2b phase fallback
findings.claim: W1d already names payload fields (subject, status, id, first_created_at) before W0b answers. No fallback is stated if the task-tools pin makes TaskCreate/TaskUpdate unavailable or changes their shape. W2b's interim phase source is W1d, so a W0b=no outcome leaves dev-flow phase and progress with no writer and no stated band text.
findings.evidence: W0b: TaskCreate/TaskUpdate payload and whether the task tool pin takes effect. W1d: fields listed. W2b: 在此之前 phase 用 W1d 目前任務名.
findings.repair: Mark W1d's field list as provisional pending W0b. Add W0b=no and partial branches: W1d is dropped and dev-flow phase/progress show 來源未接 until W2b; or W1d reads the transcript or todo file if W0b finds an equivalent. Make W2b's eval gating independent of W1d.

findings.affected_surface: W1a work-order binding, W1f ROOT_RUN_ID export, W3a phase mapping
findings.claim: W1a binds work orders to a root by directory name based on a 5/5 sample and picks the 'latest' work-order without an ordering key. It should confirm the binding against an in-file root field and leave the record unbound on mismatch. W1f's rail-side export must only propagate an existing AUTOPILOT_ROOT_RUN_ID or PARENT; it must never mint a root for ad-hoc dispatch, or it violates §2.7 (no guessing, unbound when no root). W3a does not state that awaiting_disposition (case-insensitive) maps to 進行中 or depth-0-waiting, never to 要你決定.
findings.evidence: P1W 已確認事實: root_run_id equals the work-orders dir name 5/5; mixed-case phase; awaiting_disposition is waiting on depth-0. W1f: rail 端 export 機制. §2.7: dev-flow without root shows unbound.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W 已確認事實 bullet, rows W1a, W1f, W3a; §2.7 table
findings.repair: W1a: verify the work-order's recorded root_run_id equals the dir name, otherwise report it unbound. Order by progress_receipts at or generation, not by mtime. W1f: export only when the variable is already set or the marker has root_run_id, and add a negative test that no root yields unbound. W3a: add an explicit phase-to-verdict table with case-folding and a test that awaiting_disposition does not show 要你決定.

findings.affected_surface: P1W ship split vs W4 and owner ruling
findings.claim: The release gating is self-contradictory. The owner ruling says v2.37.0 ships only after P1W 完成. 出貨切分 and the R5 log say v2.37.0 ships when the mechanism rows are done and guidance rows follow as PATCH. W4 (which produces v2.37.0) depends on 全部, including guidance rows W2a/W2b/W2c/W2e and spike-pending W3b, and is 一次 landing of W1–W3. W1d and W1e are listed among the mechanism W1* rows but wait on spikes. Per-row test requirements name RED-first and mutation but no negative controls for the new writers, such as a stale tasks file, an attention file left after its end signal, or a decision.json from a wrong root.
findings.evidence: owner 裁決: v2.37.0 等 P1W 完成後才出. 出貨切分: 機制列…齊後即可出 v2.37.0. W4 依賴 全部, 含 W1–W3. Review log R5: v2.37.0 等 P1W 機制列完成.
findings.evidence_reference: §4 P1W owner 裁決 bullet, row W4, 出貨切分 bullet; Review log R5
findings.repair: Get the owner to confirm one rule, then make W4 depend only on the mechanism rows and the new publish rows, and add a W5 per guidance row (PATCH with eval evidence). Mark W3b out of v2.37.0. State the W0a/W0b=no outcome for W1d/W1e with respect to the release. Add per-row negative controls: stale or expired file, wrong scope or root, writer absent leads to 來源未接, and the null-vs-0 fixture.
